title: 设计食物评分系统
summary: 维护食物的菜系和评分，支持修改某食物评分，并查询某菜系评分最高、并列时字典序最小的食物。
insight: 记录 food 到 cuisine 与 rating 的映射，并为每个菜系维护按评分降序、名称升序排列的有序集合。改分前先从集合删除旧状态，更新评分后重新插入。
pitfalls: 评分并列取字典序最小名称
有序集合比较依据可变评分，必须先删除再改值

solutions.title: 每菜系有序食物集合
solutions.idea: TreeSet 实时维护最高评分与字典序。
steps: 每个 cuisine 建 comparator：rating 降序、name 升序的 TreeSet
changeRating：从菜系集合 remove，更新 rating，再 add

complexity.time: O(log foodsInCuisine) 修改，O(1) 查询首项

code.java: class FoodRatings { Map<String,String> cuisines=new HashMap<>();Map<String,Integer> ratings=new HashMap<>();Map<String,TreeSet<String>> ranked=new HashMap<>();Comparator<String> order=(a,b)->{int compare=Integer.compare(ratings.get(b),ratings.get(a));return compare!=0?compare:a.compareTo(b);};public FoodRatings(String[] foods,String[] cuisines,int[] ratings){for(int i=0;i<foods.length;i++){this.cuisines.put(foods[i],cuisines[i]);this.ratings.put(foods[i],ratings[i]);ranked.computeIfAbsent(cuisines[i],key->new TreeSet<>(order)).add(foods[i]);}}public void changeRating(String food,int newRating){TreeSet<String> set=ranked.get(cuisines.get(food));set.remove(food);ratings.put(food,newRating);set.add(food);}public String highestRated(String cuisine){return ranked.get(cuisine).first();} }
code.kotlin: class FoodRatings(foods:Array<String>,cuisineValues:Array<String>,ratingValues:IntArray){private val cuisines=HashMap<String,String>();private val ratings=HashMap<String,Int>();private val ranked=HashMap<String,java.util.TreeSet<String>>();private val order=Comparator<String>{a,b->val compare=ratings[b]!!.compareTo(ratings[a]!!);if(compare!=0)compare else a.compareTo(b)};init{for(i in foods.indices){cuisines[foods[i]]=cuisineValues[i];ratings[foods[i]]=ratingValues[i];ranked.getOrPut(cuisineValues[i]){java.util.TreeSet(order)}.add(foods[i])}}fun changeRating(food:String,newRating:Int){val set=ranked[cuisines[food]]!!;set.remove(food);ratings[food]=newRating;set.add(food)}fun highestRated(cuisine:String):String=ranked[cuisine]!!.first()}
code.cpp: class FoodRatings { unordered_map<string,string> cuisines;unordered_map<string,int> ratings;unordered_map<string,set<pair<int,string>>> ranked;public:FoodRatings(vector<string>& foods,vector<string>& cuisineValues,vector<int>& ratingValues){for(int i=0;i<(int)foods.size();++i){cuisines[foods[i]]=cuisineValues[i];ratings[foods[i]]=ratingValues[i];ranked[cuisineValues[i]].insert({-ratingValues[i],foods[i]});}}void changeRating(string food,int newRating){string cuisine=cuisines[food];ranked[cuisine].erase({-ratings[food],food});ratings[food]=newRating;ranked[cuisine].insert({-newRating,food});}string highestRated(string cuisine){return ranked[cuisine].begin()->second;} };
